brief:
A book on Palestinian history has been pulled from publication after its authors accused the publisher of making unilateral changes they characterize as presenting a "Zionist framing" of their work, Middle East Eye reported. Authors Alana Hadid and Jenan Matari said the alterations were inaccurate and fundamentally shifted the manuscript's content without their consent.

The dispute centers on how the publisher modified the text's historical narrative. The authors' objections prompted the withdrawal, though the full scope of the contested changes and the publisher's position on the matter remain unclear from the available account.

title: Publisher withdraws Palestine book over disputed historical framing
